**Finding: MISSING — no insurance provision (severity: low, but walk-away territory given data processing).**

- Searches for "insurance", "cyber", and "certificate" returned zero hits; a full read of the single-section agreement (§§1–14, including General Provisions at p0063–p0073) confirms no coverage obligation exists anywhere in the body, and no exhibit is attached to the executed document.
- Kubient is squarely a services/hosting vendor: it hosts the Auction Platform (p0002, p0005) and warrants as to "the collection, maintenance, management and storage of visitor information (data) … collected, directed by, maintained or stored by Kubient" (p0035). Under the rule, a vendor processing personal data with no insurance at all is walk-away, not merely a shortfall against the fallback.
- Remedy: inserted a new General Provisions subsection (j) after p0073 with the preferred package — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates on request — with the E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M fallback offered in the comment as a negotiating path.
- The redline validated `ok:true` and the finding is submitted (confidence 0.9).
